title: Proof of Address and Social Security Number Matching in Claimant Identity Verification
content:
Two checks in Claimant Identity Verification look beyond the photo document: a proof-of-address document on the pathways that require one, and a match of the claimant's Social Security number against Social Security Administration (SSA) records. Their terms per pathway are:

| Pathway | Proof-of-address document required | Maximum age of the proof of address (calendar days, issue date to receipt) | Proof of address must show the mailing address of record | SSN matched against SSA records | Days to answer an SSA mismatch notice (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | no | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | no | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | yes | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | yes | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | yes | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | yes | 60 | yes | yes | 10 |

**Accepted proof-of-address documents (every pathway):** utility bill; lease agreement; bank statement; government letter.

## Questions answered from the table

**Which pathways require a proof-of-address document?**
In-Person Proofing — American Job Center, In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location, Documentary Verification by Mail and Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification. Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) and Video Trusted Referee Session do not.

**How old may a proof-of-address document be?**
No more than 60 calendar days, counted from the date the document was issued to the date it was received, on every pathway.

**Whose address must it show?**
On every pathway, the proof of address must show the mailing address of record on the claimant's profile.

**Is the Social Security number checked on every pathway?**
Yes. On all six pathways the number is matched against SSA records.

**How long does a claimant have after an SSA mismatch notice?**
10 calendar days after the notice, on every pathway, to submit the Social Security card or an SSA letter.

## Hypothetical illustration

A utility bill issued on day 1 and received on day 61 is 60 days old at receipt and is within the 60-day maximum; the same bill received on day 62 is 61 days old and exceeds it. (The day numbers are hypothetical inputs.)
